basis: Large consolidated-city jurisdiction with public UCR incident dashboards, explicit download instructions, a pinned Tableau view contract, a validated workbook-level Map crosstab export, and official 2024 seven-offense crime-analysis reporting.
notes: The public contract is useful for official counts and bounded packet research, but it is not a clean city-share promotion lane under the repo bar because the validated whole-view bulk geometry is too coarse and the precise mark-level export does not scale as a canonical bulk path.
source_name: MNPD UCR incidents dashboard plus crime-statistics reports
analyst_notes: Nashville now has both validated export modes: a whole-view Map crosstab with row-level incident fields and a mark-level Full Data path with precise coordinates. The decisive issue is that the bulk Map export rounds latitude/longitude to 0.1 degrees, while the precise mark-level path requires Tableau interaction per selection and does not scale as a clean canonical bulk contract.
